item.tib: rig 'dzin gsang ba thugs kyi sgrub pa sku gsum dgongs pa 'dus pa'i rgyud las zhing bsgrod smon lam mthar thug phan bde'i 'dun sa dga' ldan lha'i skyed tshal
item.coloph: bdag 'dra o rgyan bde chen gling pa mi 'gyur tshe dbang gsang sngags grags pa rtsal gyis rkong (kong) yul dpal gyi rdzong nas spyan drangs pa'o
